nights.title: No Te Va Gustar
nights.name: No Te Va Gustar
nights.extract: No Te Va Gustar, also known by their initials NTVG, is an Uruguayan rock band formed in 1994 in Malvín, Montevideo. The group consists of lead vocalist and guitarist Emiliano Brancciari, bassist Guzmán Silveira, drummer Diego Bartaburu, trumpeter Martín Gil, trombonist Denis Ramos, tenor saxophonist Mauricio Ortiz, guitarist Pablo Coniberti, and keyboardist Francisco Nasser. The group was founded by Brancciari, Mateo Moreno, and Pablo Abdala as a group of friends that played at a small festival. It is considered as the most popular and international Uruguayan rock band and one of the most recognized Latin American groups.

It is considered as the most popular and international Uruguayan rock band.

de.who: No Te Va Gustar, auch bekannt unter den Initialen NTVG, ist eine uruguayische Rockband, die 1994 in Malvín, Montevideo, gegründet wurde. Die Gruppe entstand aus einem Freundeskreis um Brancciari, Mateo Moreno und Pablo Abdala, die bei einem kleinen Festival spielten.
facts: Zur Besetzung gehören Sänger und Gitarrist Emiliano Brancciari, Bassist Guzmán Silveira, Schlagzeuger Diego Bartaburu, Trompeter Martín Gil, Posaunist Denis Ramos, Tenorsaxophonist Mauricio Ortiz, Gitarrist Pablo Coniberti und Keyboarder Francisco Nasser.
Sie gilt als die populärste und internationalste uruguayische Rockband.

tr.who: No Te Va Gustar, NTVG baş harfleriyle de bilinen, 1994'te Montevideo'nun Malvín semtinde kurulmuş bir Uruguaylı rock grubudur. Grup, Brancciari, Mateo Moreno ve Pablo Abdala tarafından, küçük bir festivalde çalan bir arkadaş grubu olarak kuruldu.
facts: Kadroda baş vokal ve gitarda Emiliano Brancciari, bassta Guzmán Silveira, davulda Diego Bartaburu, trompette Martín Gil, trombonda Denis Ramos, tenor saksofonda Mauricio Ortiz, gitarda Pablo Coniberti ve klavyede Francisco Nasser yer alıyor.
Grup, Uruguaylı en popüler ve uluslararası rock grubu olarak kabul ediliyor.

nights.title: ElGrandeToto
nights.name: ElGrandeToto
nights.extract: Taha Fahssi, better known by his stage name ElGrandeToto, EGT or just Toto, is a Moroccan rapper from Casablanca. He has been the most streamed artist in Morocco for five consecutive years (2021-2025) and was the most listened-to artist in the MENA region on Spotify in 2021 and 2023. He is also the most viewed Moroccan rapper on YouTube. Fahssi is widely regarded as one of Morocco's best rappers of all time.

en.who: Taha Fahssi, better known by his stage name ElGrandeToto, EGT or just Toto, is a Moroccan rapper from Casablanca. Fahssi is widely regarded as one of Morocco's best rappers of all time.
facts: He has been the most streamed artist in Morocco for five consecutive years (2021-2025) and was the most listened-to artist in the MENA region on Spotify in 2021 and 2023.
He is also the most viewed Moroccan rapper on YouTube.

de.who: Taha Fahssi, besser bekannt unter seinem Künstlernamen ElGrandeToto, EGT oder einfach Toto, ist ein marokkanischer Rapper aus Casablanca. Er gilt weithin als einer der besten Rapper Marokkos aller Zeiten.
facts: Fünf Jahre in Folge (2021-2025) war er der meistgestreamte Künstler in Marokko, und 2021 sowie 2023 der meistgehörte Künstler der MENA-Region auf Spotify.
Außerdem ist er der meistgesehene marokkanische Rapper auf YouTube.

tr.who: Taha Fahssi, sahne adı ElGrandeToto, kısaca EGT ya da Toto ile tanınan, Casablanca'dan bir Fas rapçisidir. Fahssi, tüm zamanların Fas'ın en iyi rapçilerinden biri olarak geniş çapta kabul edilmektedir.
facts: Art arda beş yıl (2021-2025) boyunca Fas'ta en çok dinlenen sanatçı oldu ve 2021 ile 2023'te Spotify'da MENA bölgesinde en çok dinlenen sanatçıydı.
Ayrıca YouTube'da en çok izlenen Faslı rapçidir.

nights.title: Alex Ubago
nights.name: Álex Ubago
nights.extract: Álex Ubago is a Spanish musician. He is especially known for his heartfelt voice and his ballads. He was able to record his debut album ¿Qué pides tú? when manager Iñigo Argomaniz that used to go to Alex's cousin's bar heard a demo that Alex made for his girlfriend. His first album contains songs from that first demo recording; the songs are "Sabes" and "Hay Que Ver". Alex started to tour national radios with his guitar to sing his songs live and get further exposure. Eventually, this strategy worked, and his album finally hit the charts. But he reached absolute fame with the publication of the song "Sin Miedo A Nada", featuring Amaia Montero, which is his biggest hit to date.

en.who: Álex Ubago is a Spanish musician. He is especially known for his heartfelt voice and his ballads.
facts: Alex started to tour national radios with his guitar to sing his songs live and get further exposure.

de.who: Álex Ubago ist ein spanischer Musiker. Besonders bekannt ist er für seine gefühlvolle Stimme und seine Balladen.
facts: Er ging mit seiner Gitarre bei nationalen Radiosendern auf Tour, um seine Lieder live zu singen und mehr Aufmerksamkeit zu gewinnen.
Sein erstes Album enthält Songs aus dieser ersten Demo-Aufnahme, darunter "Sabes" und "Hay Que Ver".

tr.who: Álex Ubago, İspanyol bir müzisyendir. Özellikle duygusal sesi ve baladlarıyla tanınır.
facts: Şarkılarını canlı söylemek ve daha fazla görünürlük kazanmak için gitarıyla ulusal radyolarda turne yapmaya başladı.
İlk albümünde, o ilk demo kaydından şarkılar yer alıyor; bunlar "Sabes" ve "Hay Que Ver".

nights.title: Pitbull - I'm Back!
nights.name: Pitbull
nights.extract: Armando Christian Pérez, known professionally as Pitbull, is an American rapper, singer, songwriter, and actor. He began his career in the early 2000s as a reggaeton, Latin hip-hop, and crunk performer, and signed with TVT Records to release his debut album, M.I.A.M.I. (2004). Executive produced by Lil Jon, the album entered the Billboard 200 along with his second and third albums, El Mariel (2006) and The Boatlift (2007). His fourth album, Pitbull Starring in Rebelution (2009), yielded his mainstream breakthrough, spawning the singles "I Know You Want Me " and "Hotel Room Service"—which peaked at numbers two and eight on the U.S. Billboard Hot 100, respectively.

en.who: Armando Christian Pérez, known professionally as Pitbull, is an American rapper, singer, songwriter, and actor. He began his career in the early 2000s as a reggaeton, Latin hip-hop, and crunk performer, and signed with TVT Records to release his debut album, M.I.A.M.I. (2004).

de.kicker: amerikanischer rapper und schauspieler · anfang der 2000er
de.who: Armando Christian Pérez, als Pitbull bekannt, ist ein amerikanischer Rapper, Sänger, Songwriter und Schauspieler. Er begann seine Karriere Anfang der 2000er als Reggaeton-, Latin-Hip-Hop- und Crunk-Künstler und unterschrieb bei TVT Records für sein Debütalbum M.I.A.M.I. (2004).
facts: Das Album wurde von Lil Jon produziert und stieg zusammen mit seinen zweiten und dritten Alben El Mariel (2006) und The Boatlift (2007) in die Billboard 200 ein.
Sein viertes Album Pitbull Starring in Rebelution (2009) brachte ihm den Durchbruch in den Mainstream.

tr.who: Armando Christian Pérez, sahne adı Pitbull olan Amerikalı bir rapçi, şarkıcı, söz yazarı ve oyuncudur. 2000'lerin başında reggaeton, Latin hip-hop ve crunk sanatçısı olarak kariyerine başladı ve ilk albümü M.I.A.M.I. (2004) için TVT Records ile anlaştı.
facts: Albümün yapımcılığını Lil Jon üstlendi; album, ikinci ve üçüncü albümleri El Mariel (2006) ve The Boatlift (2007) ile birlikte Billboard 200 listesine girdi.
Dördüncü albümü Pitbull Starring in Rebelution (2009), onun ana akım çıkışını sağladı.
